E_no_test_leakage.note: adaptive thresholds are computed from cached pooled frozen-detector features only (predict_taus); test GT/sweeps are read only by the oracle and for scoring

F_same_raw_detections.note: all policies use the same DetectionTable (scores, is_tp, n_gt)

G_identical_matching.note: is_tp computed once per image with generate_curves.greedy_match_labels_one_image_np (IoU 0.5, class 0)

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap: resample the 1,650 test base images with replacement; every resampled base image contributes all of its variants (pristine + all degraded variants of all regimes); TP/FP/FN are re-summed per regime and pooled, then F1 recomputed; learned policies: F1 averaged over the 3 seeds within each replicate
